name: gushwork-design-site
description: gushwork-design.vercel.app — static pages plus the Google auth gate. No build step. One dependency, @vercel/blob, imported lazily inside the two output-copy routes (api/_log-output.js, api/_purge-outputs.js) so a failure there cannot take the other routes down; it exists so Vercel treats api/*.js and middleware.js as ES modules.
